  -c, --config <key=value>
      --last
      --all
      --enable <FEATURE>
      --disable <FEATURE>
  -i, --image <FILE>
      --strict-config
  -m, --model <MODEL>
      --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
      --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
      --worktree
      --thread-source <SOURCE>
      --skip-git-repo-check
      --ephemeral
      --ignore-user-config
      --ignore-rules
      --output-schema <FILE>
      --json
  -o, --output-last-message <FILE>
  -h, --help
